crossRefs.note: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “How long will you neglect to go in to possess the land, which Yahweh, the God…
Now therefore take twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, for every tribe a man.
“Take twelve men out of the people, a man out of every tribe,
With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.
“Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their…
You shall survey the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here…
The men went and passed through the land, and surveyed it by cities into seven portions in a book. They came to Joshua…

translations.web: Appoint for yourselves three men from each tribe. I will send them, and they shall arise, walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; then they shall come to me.
translations.bsb: Appoint three men from each tribe, and I will send them out to survey the land and map it out, according to the inheritance of each. Then they will return to me
translations.kjv: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come
